title.zh-CN: 阴茎增大与声音变粗 · 8岁4月男孩
title.en: Penile growth and deepening voice · boy aged 8 years 4 months

summary.zh-CN: 8岁男孩半年来阴茎增大、变声、生长突然加快，从小发育落后：找出男性化的原因，并安全地处理所发现的问题。
summary.en: An 8-year-old boy with six months of penile growth, a breaking voice and a growth spurt, whose development has lagged since he was little: find the cause of the virilisation and act on what you find safely.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编（原文为中文）。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容——8岁4个月男孩，阴茎增大、声音变粗6个月；生长、发育、出生、手术和家族史；发育体征和外生殖器检查；睾酮与GnRH激发试验、骨龄、垂体MRI、肾上腺和睾丸等影像、两次核型；前上纵隔肿物与β-hCG；肿物切除与病理；一年随访——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（各项结果在哪个阶段出现）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色以及家长说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、基础LH、肾上腺激素、AFP数值、肿物的影像方式、症状、麻醉和手术细节、病理分级、远期结局）保持未知。1.0.0版中英文之间的几处出入作为原样保留并列入README的“To verify”。本病例没有图片。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report (written in Chinese). Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a boy of 8 years 4 months with six months of penile enlargement and a deepening voice; his growth, development, birth, operation and family history; the pubertal and genital examination; testosterone with a GnRH stimulation test, bone age, pituitary MRI, adrenal and testicular imaging and two karyotypes; the anterosuperior mediastinal mass and β-hCG; the resection and histology; the one-year follow-up — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (which result opens in which phase), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the parent's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, basal LH, adrenal steroids, the AFP value, the imaging modality of the mass, symptoms, anaesthetic and surgical details, histological grade, long-term outcome) stays unknown. The few differences between the Chinese and English text of 1.0.0 are kept and listed under "To verify" in the README. The case has no figures.

disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report (as extracted for 1.0.0); unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对照睾丸大小与男性化程度：阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期、阴茎9 cm而睾丸5–6 mL时，在评估性腺轴的同时想到外周来源，并在诊断前不使用任何抑制青春期的药物。
learningOutcomes.en: Weigh testicular volume against virilisation — stage III–IV pubic hair and a 9 cm penis with 5–6 mL testes — to keep a peripheral source in view while the axis is tested, and give no puberty-suppressing drug before a diagnosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把睾酮与GnRH激发后LH峰值（0.1 IU/L，低于ESPE/LWPES 2009提出的约3.3–5.0 IU/L青春期前上限）一起解读为促性腺激素非依赖性性早熟，并说明GnRH类似物为何对它无效。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret testosterone with a GnRH-stimulated LH peak of 0.1 IU/L (below the assay-specific prepubertal limit of about 3.3–5.0 IU/L cited by ESPE/LWPES 2009) as gonadotropin-independent precocity, and explain why a GnRH analogue cannot treat it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 不因47,XXY过早下结论：说明Klinefelter综合征导致性腺功能减退而非性早熟，并据EAA 2021和NCI PDQ 2024查找分泌hCG的生殖细胞肿瘤——查β-hCG和AFP，首先做纵隔影像。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid premature closure on 47,XXY: explain that Klinefelter syndrome causes hypogonadism rather than precocity, and search for an hCG-secreting germ-cell tumour — β-hCG and AFP, mediastinal imaging first — as EAA 2021 and NCI PDQ 2024 describe.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 前纵隔肿物在任何镇静或全麻之前，按SPA 2024病例指南评估气道和循环受压并进行多学科讨论，再安排完整手术切除。
learningOutcomes.en: Before any sedation or general anaesthetic for an anterior mediastinal mass, assess airway and circulatory compression and hold a multidisciplinary discussion as the SPA 2024 case guide describes, then plan complete resection.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定术后随访：按NCI PDQ 2024复查β-hCG、AFP和影像，追踪睾酮、LH、生长和骨龄以发现继发中枢性青春期，并按EAA 2021安排Klinefelter综合征的遗传咨询和学习支持，青春期前不用睾酮。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan follow-up after resection: β-hCG, AFP and imaging as NCI PDQ 2024 describes, testosterone, LH, growth and bone age for secondary central puberty, and Klinefelter care per EAA 2021 — genetic counselling, learning support and no testosterone before puberty needs it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在解释、征得家长和孩子同意并有陪检人员在场的情况下检查儿童的外生殖器（AAP 2025），并分阶段、用通俗语言向孩子和家长说明结果。
learningOutcomes.en: Examine a child's genitals with an explanation, the parent's consent and the child's agreement and a chaperone (AAP 2025), and explain the results to the boy and his parent in stages and in plain words.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 家长回答病史，只说病历里记录的事实（起病、长高和体重、其他发育变化、从小的发育和上学情况、出生、疝气手术、家里情况）；其他事情（用药、过敏、疫苗、激素接触、呼吸或头痛等症状、先出现哪种变化、家里人的发育年龄）如实说“这个我说不上来，医生。”，不要编。检查外生殖器前，家长希望医生先说明、征得同意，并有护士在场；孩子会害羞，用几个字回答。不要提前说出任何检查结果。
actingNotes.en: His parent gives the history and states only what his notes record (the onset, his growth and weight gain, the other changes, his development since he was little and his schooling, his birth, the hernia operation, the family). For anything else (medicines, allergies, vaccinations, contact with hormones, breathing or headache symptoms, which change came first, when relatives went through puberty) the parent says honestly "I'm not sure, doctor." and invents nothing. Before the genital examination the parent expects an explanation, consent and a nurse present; the boy is shy and answers in a few words. Never anticipate a test result.

name.zh-CN: 提交多学科讨论（儿童肿瘤、外科、麻醉、内分泌）
name.en: Refer to the multidisciplinary team (paediatric oncology, surgery, anaesthesia, endocrinology)

response.zh-CN: 已提交多学科讨论。报告没有记录多学科讨论或参与讨论的科室。
response.en: Referral made. The report does not record a multidisciplinary discussion or who took part.

name.zh-CN: 镇静或全麻前评估气道和循环（麻醉科会诊、气道和大血管CT、心脏超声）
name.en: Airway and circulation assessment before any sedation or general anaesthetic (anaesthesia review, CT of the airway and great vessels, echocardiography)

response.zh-CN: 已请麻醉科评估并安排相应检查。报告没有记录他有无气道或循环受压的症状、气道测量、心脏超声或麻醉经过，这些结果在本病例中都不存在。
response.en: Anaesthesia review and the tests are requested. The report records no symptoms of airway or circulatory compression, airway measurements, echocardiogram or anaesthetic course — none of these results exists in this case.

name.zh-CN: 全身麻醉下手术切除病灶
name.en: Surgical removal of the lesion under general anaesthesia

harm.zh-CN: 没有先评估颈部或胸部有无压迫气道和循环的肿物就施行全身麻醉，可能在诱导时发生气道塌陷或循环衰竭。SPA病例指南《前纵隔肿物患者的麻醉》（2024）：前纵隔肿物的孩子即使术前没有呼吸道症状，也可能在全麻诱导时发生心肺塌陷；麻醉前要问气道和循环受压的症状，用胸部CT评估气道、大血管和心脏受压，有压迫或积液时做经胸心脏超声，并进行多学科讨论；尽量避免全麻，必须全麻时保留自主呼吸。
harm.en: A general anaesthetic without first assessing whether a mass compresses the airway or circulation risks airway collapse or circulatory failure at induction. SPA case guide, Anesthesia for patients with anterior mediastinal mass (2024): even children with no respiratory symptoms can have cardiorespiratory compromise or collapse on induction; before anaesthesia ask about symptoms of airway and circulatory compression, assess compression of the airway, great vessels and heart on chest CT, add a transthoracic echocardiogram if there is compression or an effusion, and hold a multidisciplinary huddle; avoid general anaesthesia where possible and keep spontaneous ventilation if it is needed.

response.zh-CN: 手术已完成，所见和切除物见“手术及病理记录”。
response.en: The operation has been done; what was found and removed is in the operation and histology record.

name.zh-CN: 制定长期随访计划（标志物、影像、生长和青春期）
name.en: Write the long-term follow-up plan (markers, imaging, growth and puberty)

response.zh-CN: 随访计划已写好。报告只记录了一年随访时的情况，没有记录随访的频次和项目。
response.en: The plan is written. The report records only the one-year review, not the schedule or what was checked at each visit.

name.zh-CN: 镇静后做检查或操作（水合氯醛或咪达唑仑）
name.en: Sedate him for a scan or procedure (chloral hydrate or midazolam)

dose.zh-CN: 口服水合氯醛或静脉咪达唑仑（本病例不给出剂量）。
dose.en: Oral chloral hydrate or IV midazolam (no dose is given in this case).

harm.zh-CN: 在评估气道和循环、多学科定出方案之前给前纵隔肿物的孩子镇静，可能导致气道或循环塌陷，在影像室等手术室以外的地方尤其危险。SPA病例指南《前纵隔肿物患者的麻醉》（2024）：即使没有呼吸道症状，这样的孩子也可能在全麻诱导时塌陷；要避免过度镇静和肌张力丧失、保留自主呼吸，并先进行多学科讨论；在手术室以外操作时，一旦硬质支气管镜或ECMO不能迅速启动，就可能变得极其危险。
harm.en: Sedating a child with an anterior mediastinal mass before the airway and circulation are assessed and a team plan is agreed risks airway or circulatory collapse, above all off-site in a scanner. SPA case guide, Anesthesia for patients with anterior mediastinal mass (2024): such children can collapse on induction even without respiratory symptoms; avoid oversedation and loss of muscle tone, keep spontaneous ventilation and hold a multidisciplinary huddle first; procedures off-site can become prohibitively dangerous if rigid bronchoscopy or ECMO cannot be started quickly.

response.zh-CN: 已镇静。报告没有记录他做任何检查时是否用过镇静。
response.en: Sedation given. The report does not record whether he was sedated for any scan.

name.zh-CN: 开始GnRH类似物（亮丙瑞林缓释剂）

zh-CN: 促性腺激素释放激素类似物

dose.zh-CN: GnRH类似物缓释剂，按说明书每月或每3个月注射一次（本病例不给出剂量）。
dose.en: A GnRH analogue depot injection, monthly or three-monthly as labelled (no dose is given in this case).

harm.zh-CN: GnRH类似物通过抑制垂体促性腺激素起作用，只能治疗中枢性（促性腺激素依赖性）性早熟。ESPE/LWPES《GnRH类似物在儿童中应用的共识声明》（2009）：GnRH类似物是中枢性性早熟的标准治疗，用于中枢性性早熟以外的情况需要进一步研究、不能常规推荐。雄激素若来自垂体驱动以外，它不能降低睾酮，只会让人误以为已经在治疗，延误寻找来源；在诊断之前用药还会使激发试验无法解读。
harm.en: A GnRH analogue works by suppressing pituitary gonadotropins, so it treats only central (gonadotropin-dependent) precocious puberty. ESPE/LWPES consensus statement on the use of GnRH analogues in children (2009): GnRH analogues are the standard of care for central precocious puberty, and their use for other conditions requires further study and cannot be suggested routinely. If the androgen comes from outside pituitary drive it will not lower his testosterone, gives a false sense that he is being treated and delays the search for the source; given before the diagnosis it also makes the stimulation test uninterpretable.

response.zh-CN: 已开出。报告没有记录使用过GnRH类似物。
response.en: Prescribed. The report does not record any GnRH analogue.

name.zh-CN: 立即开始以铂类为基础的化疗

dose.zh-CN: 按肿瘤化疗方案给药（本病例不给出剂量）。
dose.en: As an oncology protocol (no dose is given in this case).

harm.zh-CN: 没有组织学诊断、没有足以确诊的肿瘤标志物水平、也没有多学科决定时，不应开始化疗。NCI PDQ《儿童颅外生殖细胞肿瘤治疗》（2024）：手术方式需要个体化——直接切除、化疗前活检，或例如在气道受压且肿瘤标志物升高时不先手术；是否化疗取决于病理或足以确诊的标志物水平。铂类药物和博来霉素可损害听力、肾脏和肺。
harm.en: Chemotherapy is not started without a tissue diagnosis or diagnostic tumour-marker levels and a multidisciplinary decision. NCI PDQ, Childhood Extracranial Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (2024): the surgical approach is individualised — primary resection, biopsy before chemotherapy, or no surgery, for example when the airway is compromised and tumour markers are raised; whether to give chemotherapy rests on the histology or diagnostic marker levels. Platinum drugs and bleomycin can damage hearing, the kidneys and the lungs.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。报告没有记录任何化疗。
response.en: Started. The report does not record any chemotherapy.

name.zh-CN: 现在出院，门诊常规随访
name.en: Discharge now with routine clinic follow-up

harm.zh-CN: 在查明病因、写好随访计划之前出院，可能漏掉需要处理的病因。男孩性早熟更常有可查的病因：ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）引用的报道中，无神经系统表现的中枢性性早熟男孩有40%存在未被怀疑的颅内病变，因此所有中枢性性早熟男孩都应做头颅MRI；促性腺激素非依赖性的表现则必须找到雄激素的来源。
harm.en: Discharging him before the cause is found and a follow-up plan is written risks missing a cause that needs treatment. Precocious puberty in boys more often has a cause to find: the ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009) cites unsuspected intracranial pathology in 40 % of boys with central precocious puberty and no neurological findings, and advises a head MRI for every boy with central precocious puberty; a gonadotropin-independent picture needs the source of the androgen found.

response.zh-CN: 出院手续已办。报告没有记录出院时间和出院时的安排。
response.en: Discharge arranged. The report does not record when he was discharged or the plan he went home with.

title.zh-CN: 了解这半年的变化和他的成长经历
title.en: Hear about the last six months and how he has grown up

hint.zh-CN: 问清什么时候开始、半年长了多少、还有哪些发育变化；再问他从小的发育、上学和交朋友的情况，以及家里人的情况。
hint.en: Ask when it started, how much he has grown and what other changes there are; then about his development since he was little, school and friends, and his family.

guidance.zh-CN: 病史主要由陪同的家长回答。
guidance.en: His parent answers most of the history.

title.zh-CN: 体格检查：先征得同意，保护隐私
title.en: Examine him — with consent and privacy

hint.zh-CN: 检查外生殖器前先解释，征得家长和孩子的同意，请陪检人员在场；把睾丸大小和男性化程度放在一起比较。
hint.en: Before the genital examination explain it, get his parent's and his own agreement and have a chaperone present; compare the size of the testes with the degree of virilisation.

hint.zh-CN: 诊断明确之前先别用药：哪些检查能告诉你垂体驱动有没有启动？
hint.en: No drugs before a diagnosis: which tests tell you whether the pituitary drive is switched on?

title.zh-CN: 解读结果并决定下一步
title.en: Read the results and decide what comes next

hint.zh-CN: LH对GnRH的反应说明了什么？一个遗传学结果能不能解释你看到的全部表现？
hint.en: What does the LH response to GnRH tell you? Can one genetic result explain everything you see?

guidance.en: Read the reports at the records terminal.

hint.zh-CN: 任何镇静或麻醉之前，先想清楚还需要评估什么、和谁一起决定。
hint.en: Before any sedation or anaesthetic, think about what still needs assessing and who should decide with you.

title.zh-CN: 安排随访并核对报告结局
title.en: Plan follow-up and compare with the reported outcome

hint.zh-CN: 一次正常的结果不等于结束：随访什么、多久、由谁负责？
hint.en: One normal result is not the end: what to follow, for how long and by whom?

guidance.zh-CN: 决策都完成后，会打开报告记录的随访结局。
guidance.en: Once the decisions are done, the reported follow-up opens.

prompt.zh-CN: 他8岁4个月，阴茎增大、声音变粗半年，半年长高8 cm；你已经问完病史、做完查体。在用任何药之前，第一批检查怎么安排？
prompt.en: He is 8 years 4 months old, with six months of penile enlargement and a deepening voice and 8 cm of growth in six months; you have taken the history and examined him. Before any drug, how do you plan the first tests?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病、生长和其他发育变化，并完成发育体征和外生殖器检查。
need.en: First ask about the onset, his growth and the other changes, and complete the pubertal and genital examination.

text.zh-CN: 先把睾丸和男性化程度对照：阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期、阴茎9 cm，双侧睾丸却只有5–6 mL。查睾酮、基础LH/FSH加GnRH激发试验和骨龄；若LH不升高，接着查肾上腺雄激素、β-hCG、AFP和影像。诊断明确前不用药。
text.en: Weigh the testes against the virilisation: stage III–IV pubic hair and a 9 cm penis, yet testes of only 5–6 mL. Send testosterone, basal LH/FSH with a GnRH stimulation test and a bone age; if LH does not rise, adrenal androgens, β-hCG, AFP and imaging next. No drug before a diagnosis.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。男孩9岁前出现青春期体征就要查原因。阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期时睾丸只有5–6 mL：睾丸虽已超过青春期前大小（≥4 mL），却与男性化程度不相称，所以评估性腺轴的同时要想到外周来源。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）要求用灵敏的LH测定，并按所用刺激药物解读激发试验；性激素水平只能辅助、不能单独确诊。诊断之前用任何抑制青春期的药，都会干扰判断。
feedback.en: Right. Signs of puberty before 9 years in a boy need a cause found. Testes of 5–6 mL beside stage III–IV pubic hair are past prepubertal size (≥ 4 mL) yet small for the degree of virilisation, so think of a peripheral source while you test the axis. The ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009) asks for sensitive LH assays and stimulation results read for the agent used; sex-steroid levels support the diagnosis but are not sufficient. Any puberty-suppressing drug before the diagnosis muddies it.

text.zh-CN: 8岁多出现阴毛、变声、喉结和生长突增，是典型的中枢性性早熟，睾丸超过4 mL也说明性腺轴已经启动：今天先开始每月一次的GnRH类似物注射，尽早保护成年身高，激素检查、骨龄片和影像检查都等第一针打完之后再一起补做。
text.en: Pubic hair, a breaking voice, an Adam's apple and a growth spurt at eight are classic central precocious puberty, and testes above 4 mL confirm the axis is on: start a monthly GnRH analogue today to protect his adult height, and complete the hormone tests, bone age and imaging after the first injection.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。中枢性性早熟要有LH的证据（基础或激发后LH达到青春期水平），不能只凭体征；他的睾丸只有5–6 mL，与阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期不相称，提示可能是外周来源。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）：GnRH类似物是中枢性性早熟的标准治疗，用于其他情况不能常规推荐；先用药还会让随后的激发试验无法解读。
feedback.en: No. Central precocious puberty needs LH evidence (a pubertal basal or stimulated LH), not signs alone, and testes of 5–6 mL beside stage III–IV pubic hair point towards a peripheral source. ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009): GnRH analogues are the standard treatment of central precocious puberty and cannot be suggested routinely for other conditions; giving one first also makes the later stimulation test uninterpretable.

text.zh-CN: 先测身高、拍骨龄片，3个月后复诊看青春期进展的快慢再决定要不要抽血；8岁多的男孩有一部分只是发育偏早，现在就做激素和影像检查，对孩子是不必要的负担。
text.en: Measure his height, take a bone age and review in three months to see how fast puberty is moving before deciding on blood tests; some boys of eight just start early, and hormone tests and scans now are a needless burden for a child.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。男孩9岁前出现青春期体征，需要现在就查病因而不是观望：变化开始才半年，查体已是阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期，半年长高8 cm，这本身就是进展。男孩的性早熟更常有可查的病因——ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）引用的报道中，无神经系统表现的中枢性性早熟男孩有40%存在未被怀疑的颅内病变。
feedback.en: No. Pubertal signs before 9 years in a boy need a cause found now, not a wait: six months after the changes began he is at pubic hair stage III–IV and has grown 8 cm — that is progression. Boys more often have a cause to find; the ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009) cites unsuspected intracranial pathology in 40 % of boys with central precocious puberty and no neurological findings.

text.zh-CN: 睾丸只有5–6 mL，雄激素多半来自肾上腺：只查17-羟孕酮、DHEA-S和肾上腺CT，并先口服氢化可的松试验性治疗，看男性化是否停止，促性腺激素和β-hCG都不必查。
text.en: With testes of only 5–6 mL the androgen is probably adrenal: check only 17-OHP, DHEA-S and an adrenal CT, start a trial of oral hydrocortisone to see whether the virilisation stops, and skip gonadotropins and β-hCG.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。5–6 mL的睾丸已超过青春期前大小，而且是双侧增大，说明有东西在刺激睾丸（LH、hCG或LH受体激活突变）；单纯肾上腺来源时睾丸通常仍是青春期前大小。没有生化诊断就用氢化可的松，既没有依据，也会干扰判断。
feedback.en: No. Testes of 5–6 mL are past prepubertal size, and both are enlarged, so something is stimulating the testes (LH, hCG or an activating LH-receptor mutation); an adrenal source alone usually leaves the testes prepubertal. Hydrocortisone without a biochemical diagnosis has no basis and muddies the picture.

prompt.zh-CN: 结果回来了：睾酮55.5 nmol/L；GnRH激发后LH峰值0.1 IU/L、FSH峰值2.15 IU/L；骨龄11岁。你怎么解读？
prompt.en: The results are back: testosterone 55.5 nmol/L; after GnRH, LH peak 0.1 IU/L and FSH peak 2.15 IU/L; bone age 11 years. How do you read them?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的睾酮与GnRH激发试验报告和骨龄报告。
need.en: First read this stage's testosterone and GnRH stimulation report and the bone age report.

text.zh-CN: 促性腺激素非依赖性（外周性）性早熟：睾酮55.5 nmol/L，而激发后LH几乎测不出（0.1 IU/L，远低于约3.3–5.0 IU/L的青春期前上限），性腺轴被抑制；GnRH类似物无效，必须找到雄激素来源。
text.en: Gonadotropin-independent (peripheral) precocious puberty: testosterone 55.5 nmol/L with a stimulated LH that is barely detectable (0.1 IU/L, far below a prepubertal limit of about 3.3–5.0 IU/L), so the axis is suppressed; a GnRH analogue cannot treat this — find the androgen's source.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）提出的青春期前LH激发峰值上限约为3.3–5.0 IU/L（与测定方法有关）；2019年国际共识更新也指出，切点取决于刺激药物、采血时间和测定方法。0.1 IU/L远低于任何青春期切点，而睾酮为55.5 nmol/L：性腺轴被抑制，雄激素不依赖促性腺激素，GnRH类似物没有作用对象。
feedback.en: Right. The ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009) cites an assay-specific prepubertal limit for the stimulated LH peak of about 3.3–5.0 IU/L, and the 2019 international consortium update notes that cut-offs depend on the stimulus, the sampling time and the assay. An LH peak of 0.1 IU/L is far below any pubertal cut-off while testosterone is 55.5 nmol/L: the axis is suppressed, the androgen does not depend on gonadotropins, and a GnRH analogue has nothing to act on.

text.zh-CN: 进展快的中枢性性早熟：睾酮高、骨龄超前2年8个月、半年长高8 cm，说明性腺轴已经充分启动；LH峰值低只是激发试验的采血时间点不对或测定方法不灵敏造成的，应开始GnRH类似物治疗，3个月后复查激发试验、骨龄和身高。
text.en: Rapidly progressive central precocious puberty: a high testosterone, a bone age 2 years 8 months ahead and 8 cm of growth in six months show a fully active axis; the low LH peak only reflects badly timed sampling or an insensitive assay, so start a GnRH analogue and repeat the stimulation test and bone age in three months.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。不管在哪个时间点采血，激发后LH峰值0.1 IU/L都是青春期前水平；中枢启动时LH应达到青春期水平。睾酮高而LH被抑制，正是外周来源的特征。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）：GnRH类似物用于中枢性性早熟，其他情况不能常规推荐。
feedback.en: No. A stimulated LH peak of 0.1 IU/L is prepubertal whatever the sampling time; central activation would bring LH into the pubertal range. A high testosterone with a suppressed LH is the signature of a peripheral source. ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009): GnRH analogues are for central precocious puberty and cannot be suggested routinely for other conditions.

text.zh-CN: 化验误差：8岁孩子的睾酮不可能到55.5 nmol/L，应先怀疑标本或单位出了错，复查一次，在结果回来之前不做其他检查，也不下任何结论。
text.en: A laboratory error: an 8-year-old cannot have a testosterone of 55.5 nmol/L, so suspect a sample or unit mix-up, repeat it once, and do no other test and draw no conclusion until it is back.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的表现——半年的男性化、长高8 cm、骨龄11岁——与雄激素过多一致。有疑问时可以复查确认，但不能因此停下检查：睾酮高而LH被抑制，本身就是继续寻找来源的信号。
feedback.en: No. His picture — six months of virilisation, 8 cm of growth, a bone age of 11 years — fits real androgen excess. A confirmatory repeat is reasonable if in doubt, but it must not halt the work-up: a high testosterone with a suppressed LH is itself the signal to look for a source.

text.zh-CN: 先天性肾上腺皮质增生症：骨龄超前、男性化、LH受抑制，最常见的原因是21-羟化酶缺乏，应直接开始氢化可的松，不必再去找其他来源。
text.en: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia: an advanced bone age, virilisation and a suppressed LH are most often 21-hydroxylase deficiency, so start hydrocortisone now and stop looking for another source.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。先天性肾上腺皮质增生症是外周性性早熟的一种原因，但他的双侧睾丸已增大到5–6 mL，提示睾丸本身受到刺激；本阶段也可以调阅肾上腺影像。病历中没有17-羟孕酮结果，不能凭推测开始氢化可的松。
feedback.en: No. Congenital adrenal hyperplasia is one cause of peripheral precocity, but both his testes are enlarged to 5–6 mL, which points to stimulation of the testes themselves, and the adrenal imaging can be read at this stage. His notes hold no 17-OHP result, so hydrocortisone cannot be started on a guess.

prompt.zh-CN: 外周性性早熟：双侧睾丸5–6 mL，垂体MRI及肾上腺、睾丸等影像未见异常，两次染色体核型均为47,XXY。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Peripheral precocious puberty: both testes 5–6 mL, pituitary MRI and adrenal, testicular and other imaging unremarkable, and two karyotypes of 47,XXY. What next?

need.zh-CN: 先完成上一个判断，并调阅本阶段的染色体核型、垂体MRI和肾上腺、睾丸等影像报告。
need.en: First answer the previous question and read this stage's karyotype, pituitary MRI and adrenal and testicular imaging reports.

text.zh-CN: 47,XXY本身导致性腺功能减退而不是性早熟，不能用它解释。双侧睾丸增大而肾上腺和睾丸未见病灶，提示有hCG一类的物质在刺激睾丸间质细胞：查β-hCG和AFP，先做胸部（纵隔）影像，并确认头颅影像覆盖了松果体和鞍上区。
text.en: 47,XXY itself causes hypogonadism, not precocity, so it cannot explain this. Two enlarged testes with no adrenal or testicular lesion suggest an hCG-like stimulus to the Leydig cells: measure β-hCG and AFP, image the chest (mediastinum) first, and check the brain imaging covered the pineal and suprasellar regions.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。EAA《Klinefelter综合征指南》（2021）：患者性腺外生殖细胞肿瘤的发生率增高，主要位于纵隔，通常为非精原细胞瘤（成熟畸胎瘤或混合性肿瘤），年龄较小的男孩可因肿瘤产生hCG而表现为性早熟。hCG作用于睾丸间质细胞的LH受体，使睾酮升高，而生精小管很少增长，所以睾丸只是中度增大。NCI PDQ（2024）也把Klinefelter综合征列为纵隔生殖细胞肿瘤的危险因素。
feedback.en: Right. EAA guideline on Klinefelter syndrome (2021): extragonadal germ-cell tumours are more frequent, located mainly in the mediastinum and usually non-seminomas (mature teratomas or mixed tumours), and younger boys may present with precocious puberty due to hCG production. hCG acts on the Leydig cells' LH receptor and drives testosterone with little growth of the seminiferous tubules, so the testes enlarge only moderately. NCI PDQ (2024) also lists Klinefelter syndrome as a risk for mediastinal germ-cell tumours.

text.zh-CN: 47,XXY已经解释了全部表现：Klinefelter综合征常有学习困难、与人交流困难和内分泌异常，这些都与他的情况相符，病因已经明确。安排遗传咨询，让他出院，每半年在内分泌门诊复查一次睾酮和身高，不需要再做影像检查。
text.en: 47,XXY explains the whole picture: Klinefelter syndrome brings learning difficulties, trouble communicating with peers and endocrine problems, all of which fit him, so the cause is found. Arrange genetic counselling, discharge him to six-monthly endocrine clinic checks of testosterone and height, and do no more imaging.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，这是过早下结论。Klinefelter综合征导致的是原发性性腺功能减退（睾酮偏低、LH升高），而他是睾酮高、LH被抑制，方向正好相反。EAA指南（2021）提醒：Klinefelter综合征的男孩可因产生hCG的生殖细胞肿瘤（多在纵隔）而出现性早熟，医生应注意这一肿瘤风险，以免错过早期发现和治疗的机会。
feedback.en: No — premature closure. Klinefelter syndrome causes primary hypogonadism, a low testosterone with a high LH; he has a high testosterone with a suppressed LH, the opposite. The EAA guideline (2021) warns that boys with Klinefelter syndrome may present with precocious puberty from hCG-producing germ-cell tumours, mostly mediastinal, and that physicians should be aware of the tumour risk so as not to lose the chance of early detection and treatment.

text.zh-CN: 这是家族性男性限性性早熟（LH受体激活突变）的典型表现：双侧睾丸增大、睾酮高而LH被抑制。开始比卡鲁胺加阿那曲唑阻断雄激素的作用，给他和父亲送LHCGR基因检测，其他影像检查都不必再做。
text.en: This is classic familial male-limited precocious puberty (an activating LH-receptor mutation): two enlarged testes, a high testosterone and a suppressed LH. Start bicalutamide with anastrozole to block the androgen's effects, send LHCGR gene testing on him and his father, and skip any further imaging.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。家族性男性限性性早熟确实会出现双侧睾丸增大和LH受抑制，但要先用β-hCG和影像排除分泌hCG的肿瘤，才轮到考虑它；他弟弟的生长和外生殖器没有发现异常，记录的家族史也没有指向它。在找到来源之前阻断雄激素，可能掩盖一个需要切除的肿瘤。
feedback.en: No. Familial male-limited precocious puberty does give two enlarged testes with a suppressed LH, but it comes into question only after β-hCG and imaging have excluded an hCG-secreting tumour; his younger brother's growth and genitals showed nothing abnormal, and nothing in the recorded family history points to it. Blocking the androgen before its source is found can hide a tumour that needs removing.

text.zh-CN: 两侧睾丸增大而影像正常，可能是影像漏掉了很小的间质细胞瘤：安排双侧睾丸活检或手术探查，明确之后再考虑其他检查。
text.en: Two enlarged testes with normal imaging may hide a small Leydig-cell tumour the scan missed: arrange bilateral testicular biopsy or surgical exploration, and consider other tests once that is settled.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。间质细胞瘤通常使一侧睾丸增大，超声多能发现；两侧睾丸大小相近地增大，提示是循环中的刺激物，例如hCG。在找到原因之前对睾丸做活检或探查，既有创，方向也错了。
feedback.en: No. A Leydig-cell tumour usually enlarges one testis and is usually seen on ultrasound; two testes enlarged to a similar size point to a circulating stimulus such as hCG. Biopsy or exploration of the testes before the cause is found is invasive and looks in the wrong place.

prompt.zh-CN: 胸部影像：前上纵隔肿物；β-hCG 16.0 IU/L（当地参考上限5.3）。对这个肿物，下一步怎么安排？
prompt.en: Chest imaging: a mass in the anterosuperior mediastinum; β-hCG 16.0 IU/L (local upper limit 5.3). What is the plan for the mass?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的胸部影像和β-hCG与AFP结果。
need.en: First read this stage's chest imaging and the β-hCG and AFP results.

text.zh-CN: 提交肿瘤、外科和麻醉多学科讨论；任何镇静或全麻前先评估气道和循环受压（症状、胸部CT看气管和大血管、必要时心脏超声），据此定麻醉方案，尽量保留自主呼吸；再完整切除送全面病理，术前留β-hCG和AFP基线。
text.en: Take him to an oncology, surgery and anaesthesia team; before any sedation or anaesthetic, assess airway and circulatory compression (symptoms, chest CT of the airway and vessels, echo if needed) and plan the anaesthetic on it, keeping spontaneous breathing; then resect completely for full histology, with baseline β-hCG and AFP.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SPA病例指南《前纵隔肿物患者的麻醉》（2024）：前纵隔肿物的孩子即使术前没有呼吸道症状，也可能在全麻诱导时发生心肺塌陷；麻醉前要问气道和循环受压的症状，用胸部CT评估气道、大血管和心脏受压，有压迫或积液时做经胸心脏超声，并进行包括肿瘤、外科、重症和麻醉的多学科讨论；尽量避免全麻，必须全麻时保留自主呼吸。NCI PDQ（2024）：儿童颅外生殖细胞肿瘤的手术方式要个体化，可以直接切除。
feedback.en: Right. SPA case guide, Anesthesia for patients with anterior mediastinal mass (2024): a child with an anterior mediastinal mass can have cardiorespiratory collapse on induction even without respiratory symptoms; ask about symptoms of airway and circulatory compression, assess compression of the airway, great vessels and heart on chest CT, add a transthoracic echocardiogram if there is compression or an effusion, and hold a multidisciplinary huddle (oncology, surgery, critical care, anaesthesia); avoid general anaesthesia where possible and keep spontaneous ventilation if it is needed. NCI PDQ (2024): for childhood extracranial germ-cell tumours the surgical approach is individualised and may be primary resection.

text.zh-CN: β-hCG升高就足以诊断恶性生殖细胞肿瘤，不必再冒险取组织：今天开始以顺铂为基础的化疗，每个疗程复查β-hCG，等肿物缩小一半以上再考虑手术，这样可以免去一次风险很大的大手术，也能更早控制激素的分泌和男性化。
text.en: A raised β-hCG is enough to diagnose a malignant germ-cell tumour, so no tissue is needed: start cisplatin-based chemotherapy today, recheck the β-hCG with each cycle and consider surgery only once the mass has shrunk by half, sparing him a high-risk operation under anaesthesia and bringing the hormone under control sooner.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。β-hCG 16.0 IU/L约为当地上限的3倍，本身不能确定是恶性肿瘤：NCI PDQ（2024）指出，良性和未成熟畸胎瘤也可以产生AFP和β-hCG的小幅升高，手术方式要个体化。没有病理就化疗，会让他承受铂类药物和博来霉素对听力、肾脏和肺的损害，而肿瘤未必对化疗有反应。
feedback.en: No. A β-hCG of 16.0 IU/L, about three times the local upper limit, does not by itself establish a malignant tumour: NCI PDQ (2024) notes that benign and immature teratomas may also produce small elevations of AFP and β-hCG, and the surgical approach is individualised. Chemotherapy without histology exposes him to the hearing, kidney and lung toxicity of platinum drugs and bleomycin for a tumour that may not respond.

text.zh-CN: 今天就在CT室给他镇静（口服水合氯醛或静脉咪达唑仑），做CT引导下穿刺活检，拿到病理再决定化疗还是手术；麻醉科等到正式手术前再会诊，免得他在病房里多等几天、反复抽血检查。
text.en: Sedate him in the CT room today (oral chloral hydrate or IV midazolam) for a CT-guided needle biopsy, choose chemotherapy or surgery on the histology, and leave the anaesthetic review until just before any definitive operation so that he does not wait days on the ward for a theatre slot.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。SPA病例指南（2024）：即使没有呼吸道症状，前纵隔肿物的孩子也可能在全麻诱导时塌陷，所以任何镇静或麻醉都要在气道和循环评估、多学科讨论之后再计划；在影像室等手术室以外的地方操作，一旦硬质支气管镜或ECMO等抢救手段不能迅速启动，就可能变得极其危险。
feedback.en: No. SPA case guide (2024): a child with an anterior mediastinal mass can collapse on induction of anaesthesia even without respiratory symptoms, so any sedation or anaesthetic is planned only after the airway and circulation assessment and a multidisciplinary huddle; a procedure off-site, such as in the scanner, can become prohibitively dangerous if rigid bronchoscopy or ECMO cannot be started quickly.

text.zh-CN: 肿物和性早熟有关，就先用GnRH类似物加抗雄激素抑制青春期，3个月后复查影像，看肿物有没有缩小，没有缩小再考虑手术。
text.en: Because the mass goes with the precocity, suppress puberty first with a GnRH analogue plus an anti-androgen, repeat the imaging in three months, and operate only if the mass has not shrunk.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。抑制青春期的药物不能治疗肿瘤：GnRH类似物对促性腺激素非依赖性的雄激素来源没有作用（ESPE/LWPES共识2009：GnRH类似物用于中枢性性早熟），抗雄激素只是掩盖它的作用；等待3个月，等于把一个可能压迫气道和大血管的肿瘤留着不治。
feedback.en: No. Puberty-suppressing drugs do not treat a tumour: a GnRH analogue has no effect on a gonadotropin-independent androgen source (ESPE/LWPES consensus 2009: GnRH analogues are for central precocious puberty), and an anti-androgen only hides its effect; three months of waiting leaves untreated a tumour that sits where it can press on the airway and great vessels.

prompt.zh-CN: 切除的肿物约8×5×4 cm，病理为囊实性畸胎瘤。他的长期随访怎么安排？
prompt.en: The resected mass measured about 8×5×4 cm, and the histology was a cystic-solid teratoma. How do you plan his long-term follow-up?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅手术及病理记录。
need.en: First read the operation and histology record.

text.zh-CN: 按生殖细胞肿瘤随访：定期查β-hCG、AFP（例如前6个月每月一次，此后每3个月一次至满2年）和胸部影像；追踪睾酮、LH、生长和骨龄，留意继发中枢性青春期；安排遗传咨询和学习、言语支持，青春期再评估雄激素和生育问题。
text.en: Follow him as after a germ-cell tumour: β-hCG, AFP (e.g. monthly for 6 months, then 3-monthly to 2 years) and chest imaging; track testosterone, LH, growth and bone age for secondary central puberty; arrange genetic counselling and learning and speech support, revisiting androgens and fertility at adolescence.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。NCI PDQ（2024）：儿童颅外生殖细胞肿瘤治疗后可每月查AFP和β-hCG共6个月，再每3个月一次至满2年，并做原发部位影像和每年胸片；畸胎瘤术后虽没有统一方案，所有儿童都要在3年内频繁复查肿瘤标志物。雄激素来源去除后，骨龄已超前的男孩可能出现继发中枢性性早熟，要用LH证实后再处理。EAA指南（2021）：向患者和父母提供遗传咨询；青春期前儿童如有需要给予言语治疗、学习监测、社交训练和心理支持；不对青春期前男孩用睾酮。
feedback.en: Right. NCI PDQ (2024): after treatment of childhood extracranial germ-cell tumours, AFP and β-hCG may be checked monthly for 6 months and then every 3 months to 2 years, with imaging of the primary site and an annual chest X-ray; after a teratoma there is no standard schedule, but markers are measured frequently for 3 years in all children. Once the androgen source is removed, a boy whose bone age has advanced can enter central puberty, which is shown by LH before it is treated. EAA guideline (2021): offer genetic counselling to patients and parents; speech therapy, monitoring of learning, social training and psychological support for pre-pubertal children if needed; no testosterone in pre-pubertal boys.

text.zh-CN: 肿物已经切除，病理又是畸胎瘤，术后β-hCG一恢复正常就可以算治愈：结束肿瘤随访，不再做影像检查，以后只在当地儿保看生长发育，Klinefelter综合征等到成年以后出现性腺功能减退时再处理。
text.en: The mass is out and it was a teratoma, so once the β-hCG is normal he can be counted as cured: end tumour follow-up and imaging, keep only growth checks at his local child-health clinic, and deal with Klinefelter syndrome in adulthood when hypogonadism appears.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。一次β-hCG正常不等于治愈：NCI PDQ（2024）指出，畸胎瘤术后所有儿童都要在3年内频繁复查肿瘤标志物，而且以成熟或未成熟成分为主的畸胎瘤中可能藏有少量恶性成分，需要依据完整的病理决定后续处理。Klinefelter综合征需要从儿童期开始的持续照护（EAA指南2021）。
feedback.en: No. One normal β-hCG is not a cure: NCI PDQ (2024) has tumour markers measured frequently for 3 years in all children after a teratoma, and malignant elements may form a small fraction of a predominantly mature or immature teratoma, so the full histology decides what comes next. Klinefelter syndrome needs care from childhood on (EAA guideline 2021).

text.zh-CN: Klinefelter综合征最终会出现睾丸功能衰竭：术后马上开始睾酮替代，防止雄激素下降后青春期倒退、影响身高和情绪；β-hCG、AFP、胸部影像和骨龄等其他随访检查都可以停掉，减少孩子来医院、抽血和拍片的次数。
text.en: Klinefelter syndrome ends in testicular failure, so start testosterone replacement straight after surgery to stop his puberty regressing as his androgens fall and harming his height and mood, and drop the β-hCG, AFP, chest imaging and bone-age checks to spare him repeated hospital visits, blood tests and X-rays.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。EAA指南（2021）建议不对婴儿和青春期前的Klinefelter综合征男孩使用睾酮；只有在青春期延迟，或出现低至正常低限的睾酮伴LH高于正常的性腺功能减退时，并在讨论生育问题之后，才开始睾酮替代。他刚因雄激素过多就诊，再加睾酮会使骨龄进一步提前。
feedback.en: No. EAA guideline (2021): no testosterone for infants and pre-pubertal boys with Klinefelter syndrome; replacement is for delayed puberty or hypogonadism with a low-normal testosterone and a supranormal LH, after fertility has been addressed. He has just presented with androgen excess, and more testosterone would push his bone age further ahead.

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤切除后性腺轴一定会被激活：术后常规给GnRH类似物直到11岁，不用复查LH，也不需要再拍骨龄片，这样可以少抽血、少拍片。
text.en: Removing the tumour will certainly switch his axis on, so give a GnRH analogue routinely after surgery until he is 11, without rechecking LH or bone age, to spare him blood tests and X-rays.

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。继发中枢性性早熟可能出现，但要先用LH（必要时做GnRH激发试验）证实，而不是常规用药。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）：GnRH类似物用于中枢性性早熟，其他情况不能常规推荐；随访中的骨龄和LH正是判断是否需要治疗的依据。
feedback.en: No. Secondary central puberty may follow, but it has to be shown by LH (with a stimulation test if needed) before any treatment, not assumed. ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009): GnRH analogues are for central precocious puberty and cannot be suggested routinely otherwise; bone age and LH at follow-up are what decide whether he needs one.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病、生长、其他发育变化，以及从小的发育和上学情况
text.en: Took the story of the onset, his growth, the other changes, his early development and his schooling

text.zh-CN: 问了出生、手术、家族情况和外源性激素接触
text.en: Asked about his birth, operations, family and any contact with outside hormones

text.zh-CN: 检查外生殖器之前已解释、征得家长和孩子的同意并有陪检人员在场
text.en: Explained, gained the parent's consent and the boy's agreement, and had a chaperone before the genital examination

text.zh-CN: 检查了身高、皮肤、体毛分期和外生殖器（阴茎和睾丸容积）
text.en: Examined height, skin, hair staging and the genitals (penis and testicular volumes)

text.zh-CN: 用药前的第一批检查：对照睾丸与男性化程度、评估性腺轴并想到外周来源（第一次即答对）
text.en: First tests before any drug: testes weighed against virilisation, the axis tested, a peripheral source kept in view (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 调阅了激素与激发试验、骨龄、垂体和肾上腺睾丸影像及核型报告，并申请了肾上腺雄激素检查
text.en: Read the hormone and stimulation, bone age, pituitary, adrenal-testicular imaging and karyotype reports, and requested adrenal androgens

text.zh-CN: 从激发后LH被抑制判断为促性腺激素非依赖性性早熟（第一次即答对）
text.en: Read the suppressed stimulated LH as gonadotropin-independent precocity (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 没有停在染色体结果上：第一次即决定找分泌hCG的肿瘤，并实际申请了β-hCG/AFP和胸部影像
text.en: Did not stop at the karyotype: chose the search for an hCG-secreting tumour first time and actually ordered β-hCG/AFP and chest imaging

text.zh-CN: 全麻手术之前先完成气道和循环评估，评估之前没有施行麻醉或镇静
text.en: Completed the airway and circulation assessment before the operation, with no anaesthetic or sedation before it

text.zh-CN: 肿物的处理方案正确（第一次即答对），并提交了多学科讨论
text.en: Planned the mass's management correctly (first attempt) and referred to the multidisciplinary team

text.zh-CN: 术后随访方案正确（第一次即答对），并写下了长期随访计划
text.en: Planned follow-up after the operation correctly (first attempt) and wrote the long-term plan

text.zh-CN: 安排了遗传咨询，以及发育、言语和学习方面的支持
text.en: Arranged genetic counselling and developmental, speech and learning support

text.zh-CN: 没有在诊断前用GnRH类似物，没有在没有病理时化疗，也没有在随访计划前让他出院
text.en: Gave no GnRH analogue before a diagnosis, no chemotherapy without histology, and no discharge before a follow-up plan

text.zh-CN: 向孩子和家长分阶段解释发现、保护隐私，并用回授法核实理解
text.en: Explained the findings to the boy and his parent in stages, protected his privacy and checked understanding by teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评判。开始时询问家长和孩子的担忧（家长：“他才8岁，怎么就这样了？我就怕是什么不好的病。”），用通俗的话解释每一步要做什么、为什么做。检查外生殖器前解释、征得家长和孩子同意、有陪检人员在场、保护隐私（AAP 2025：是否陪检、由谁陪检由患儿、家长和医生共同决定）。核型和胸部结果出来后，用SPIKES分阶段告知：先了解家长已知道什么，坏消息前给出预告（例如“片子上胸腔里有一个肿物，很可能就是它在产生激素”），说明Klinefelter综合征现在和将来意味着什么（学习、青春期、生育），不要一次说太多；解释为什么麻醉前要先评估气道，以及手术的目的；不承诺“治好”。考虑到他与同学交流有困难，用适合他的方式让孩子本人参与。最后用回授法请家长复述计划。原报告没有记录与家属的沟通。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge with Calgary–Cambridge. Start by asking the parent and the boy what worries them (the parent: "He's only eight — why is this happening? I'm afraid it's something bad.") and explain each step and its reason in plain words. Before the genital examination explain it, gain the parent's consent and the boy's agreement, have a chaperone and protect his privacy (AAP 2025: whether a chaperone is used, and who, is decided jointly by patient, parent and clinician). When the karyotype and chest results are known, give the news in stages with SPIKES: find out what the parent knows, warn before bad news ("the scan shows a lump in the chest that is probably making the hormone"), explain what Klinefelter syndrome means now and later (learning, puberty, fertility) without overloading, explain why the airway is checked before any anaesthetic and what the operation is for, and promise no cure. Involve the boy at his own level, given his difficulty communicating with classmates. Close with teach-back of the plan. The report records no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 岑医生（儿科内分泌带教老师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是一例历史病例教学，按时间推进：入院病史与查体、第一批检查、结果解读、进一步寻找来源、处理新的发现、随访。用苏格拉底式提问引导：睾丸大小和男性化程度相称吗？在用任何药之前要先证明什么？LH对GnRH的反应说明性腺轴处于什么状态？一个遗传学结果能解释全部表现吗？任何镇静或麻醉之前要先评估什么、和谁一起决定？复盘按PEARLS进行（反应、描述、分析、总结）。不提前透露检查结果、诊断或结局；病历没有记录的内容（生命体征、基础LH、17-羟孕酮、AFP数值、手术方式、病理分级、麻醉经过）不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case that moves through time: admission history and examination, the first tests, reading the results, looking further for the source, acting on what is found, and follow-up. Use Socratic questions: are the testes in proportion to the virilisation? What must be shown before any drug is started? What does the LH response to GnRH say about the axis? Can one genetic result explain everything? What needs assessing, and with whom, before any sedation or anaesthetic? Debrief with PEARLS (reactions, description, analysis, summary). Do not reveal results, the diagnosis or the outcome early, and do not supply what the notes do not record (vital signs, basal LH, 17-OHP, the AFP value, the surgical approach, the histological grade, the anaesthetic course).

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士，负责余知远。交班（ISBAR）：余知远，8岁4个月男孩，家长陪同；因阴茎增大、声音变粗6个月入院；半年长高8 cm；病历卡记录体重30 kg（测量时间未记录）；病历中没有记录生命体征、过敏和用药。可以在外生殖器检查时担任陪检，抽血、预约检查和联系会诊；报告出来后在病历终端调阅。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse looking after Yu Zhiyuan. Handover (ISBAR): Yu Zhiyuan, 8 years 4 months, with his parent; admitted with six months of penile enlargement and a deepening voice; 8 cm of growth in six months; his card records a weight of 30 kg (when it was measured is not recorded); his notes record no vital signs, allergies or medicines. Can chaperone the genital examination, take blood, book tests and call consultants; reports are read at the records terminal as they come.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科麻醉医生，负责镇静和全麻前的评估。对任何可能压迫气道或大血管的颈部或胸部肿物：先问咳嗽、气促、喘鸣、声音嘶哑和平卧时呼吸困难（气道受压），以及晕厥、心动过速、颈静脉怒张和上腔静脉综合征（心血管受压）；需要近期的胸部CT评估气道、大血管和心脏受压，有压迫或积液时做经胸心脏超声（准备镇静或麻醉时门槛要低）；即使没有症状也可能在全麻诱导时塌陷；尽量避免全麻，必须全麻时保留自主呼吸、避免肌松，手术室备好硬质支气管镜，高危时准备ECMO；需要肿瘤、外科、重症和麻醉的多学科讨论（SPA病例指南2024）。只知道学员告诉或给他看的这个孩子的情况，不补充病历中没有的症状或检查结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric anaesthetist who assesses children before sedation or general anaesthesia. For any neck or chest mass that could compress the airway or great vessels: asks about cough, breathlessness, stridor, hoarseness and trouble breathing lying flat (airway compression), and about fainting, a fast heart rate, distended neck veins and superior vena cava syndrome (cardiovascular compression); needs recent chest CT for compression of the airway, great vessels and heart, and a transthoracic echocardiogram if there is compression or an effusion (a low threshold when sedation or anaesthesia is planned); knows collapse can occur on induction even without symptoms; avoids general anaesthesia where possible and otherwise keeps spontaneous breathing and avoids paralysis, with a rigid bronchoscope in theatre and ECMO ready for high-risk cases; wants a multidisciplinary huddle with oncology, surgery and critical care (SPA case guide 2024). Knows only what the learner tells or shows about this boy and adds no symptom or result his notes do not hold.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：一个男孩的外周性性早熟与47,XXY
title.en: Debrief: peripheral precocious puberty in a boy with 47,XXY

conclusion.zh-CN: 余知远，8岁4个月男孩，阴茎增大、声音变粗6个月，伴痤疮、喉结出现和勃起（无遗精），半年长高8 cm、增重5 kg；从小生长发育落后，学习较差，与同学交流困难。查体：身高132 cm，面部、胸部和背部痤疮，有腋毛，阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期，阴茎长9 cm、周径8 cm，双侧睾丸5–6 mL。睾酮55.5 nmol/L，GnRH激发后LH峰值0.1 IU/L、FSH峰值2.15 IU/L，骨龄11岁，垂体MRI及肾上腺、睾丸等影像未见异常——促性腺激素非依赖性（外周性）性早熟；两次核型均为47,XXY。后续发现前上纵隔肿物，β-hCG 16.0 IU/L（当地上限5.3）；切除约8×5×4 cm肿物，病理为囊实性畸胎瘤。一年随访男性化减慢，睾酮8.49 nmol/L，β-hCG 0.7 IU/L，胸片未见异常；因这些结果未复查MRI，报告仍强调警惕残留。今天的做法：把睾丸和男性化程度对照，先证明性腺轴被抑制，不在染色体结果处停下，查β-hCG和AFP并做纵隔影像，任何麻醉前先评估气道和循环，完整切除，再随访标志物、影像、青春期和Klinefelter综合征。
conclusion.en: Yu Zhiyuan, aged 8 years 4 months, had six months of penile enlargement and voice deepening, with acne, a laryngeal prominence and erections (no nocturnal emissions), and had grown 8 cm and gained 5 kg in six months; his growth and development had been behind since he was little, his schoolwork was rather poor and he had difficulty communicating with classmates. Examination: height 132 cm, acne on the face, chest and back, axillary hair, pubic hair stage III–IV, a penis 9 cm long and 8 cm in circumference, both testes 5–6 mL. Testosterone was 55.5 nmol/L with a GnRH-stimulated LH peak of 0.1 IU/L and FSH peak of 2.15 IU/L, bone age 11 years, and pituitary MRI and adrenal and testicular imaging unremarkable — gonadotropin-independent (peripheral) precocious puberty; two karyotypes showed 47,XXY. An anterosuperior mediastinal mass was subsequently found, with β-hCG 16.0 IU/L (local upper limit 5.3); an approximately 8×5×4 cm mass was resected and histology showed a cystic-solid teratoma. At one year of follow-up virilisation had slowed, testosterone was 8.49 nmol/L, β-hCG 0.7 IU/L and the chest radiograph showed no abnormality; because of these results the MRI was not repeated, and the report still urged vigilance for residual disease. Today's answer: weigh the testes against the virilisation, show that the axis is suppressed, do not stop at the karyotype, measure β-hCG and AFP and image the mediastinum, assess the airway and circulation before any anaesthetic, resect completely, then follow markers, imaging, puberty and Klinefelter care.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 睾丸要和男性化程度对照：阴毛Ⅲ–Ⅳ期、阴茎9 cm，而双侧睾丸只有5–6 mL——在评估中枢启动的同时要想到外周来源。
keyReasoning.en: Read the testes against the virilisation: stage III–IV pubic hair and a 9 cm penis with testes of only 5–6 mL keeps a peripheral source in view alongside central activation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 睾酮55.5 nmol/L而GnRH激发后LH峰值仅0.1 IU/L：性腺轴被抑制，这是促性腺激素非依赖性性早熟，GnRH类似物没有作用对象。
keyReasoning.en: Testosterone 55.5 nmol/L with a GnRH-stimulated LH peak of 0.1 IU/L: the axis is suppressed, so this is gonadotropin-independent precocity and a GnRH analogue has nothing to act on.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肾上腺和睾丸影像未见异常、双侧睾丸增大：要找循环中的LH样刺激物——在男孩，hCG可以直接刺激睾丸间质细胞。
keyReasoning.en: Unremarkable adrenal and testicular imaging with two enlarged testes means looking for a circulating LH-like stimulus — in a boy, hCG drives the Leydig cells directly.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 47,XXY是线索而不是解释：Klinefelter综合征本身导致性腺功能减退；它和外周性性早熟同时出现，提示分泌hCG的纵隔生殖细胞肿瘤，要查β-hCG和AFP并做胸部影像。
keyReasoning.en: 47,XXY is a clue, not the explanation: Klinefelter syndrome causes hypogonadism; together with peripheral precocity it points to an hCG-secreting mediastinal germ-cell tumour — measure β-hCG and AFP and image the chest.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 前纵隔肿物首先是麻醉风险：镇静或全麻之前评估气道和循环、多学科定方案，再完整切除，之后随访标志物、影像和青春期。
keyReasoning.en: An anterior mediastinal mass is first an anaesthetic hazard: assess the airway and circulation and plan with the team before any sedation or anaesthetic, then resect completely and follow markers, imaging and puberty.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此估计Klinefelter综合征男孩发生纵隔肿瘤的概率，也不能比较不同的手术或随访方式。报告的处理作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。病历没有记录生命体征、基础LH、肾上腺激素、AFP数值、肿物的影像方式及其与气道的关系、手术方式、病理分级和一年以后的经过。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot estimate how often boys with Klinefelter syndrome develop mediastinal tumours, nor compare operations or follow-up schedules. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions, intervention options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The notes record no vital signs, basal LH, adrenal steroids, AFP value, imaging modality or airway relation of the mass, surgical approach, histological grade or course beyond one year.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（包括血压），以及皮肤、心肺、神经系统和视野等其他检查。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (including blood pressure), and the skin, cardiorespiratory, neurological and visual-field examinations.

unknowns.zh-CN: 基础LH和FSH、各项参考范围、激发药物和采血时间点；17-羟孕酮、DHEA-S和雄烯二酮；AFP数值（报告中部分单位有疑问）；β-hCG的采血时间与胸部影像和手术的先后关系。
unknowns.en: Basal LH and FSH, the reference ranges, the stimulating agent and sampling times; 17-OHP, DHEA-S and androstenedione; the AFP values (some units in the report are questionable); when the β-hCG was taken relative to the chest imaging and the operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肿物的影像方式、大小以及与气道和大血管的关系；有无呼吸或循环症状；麻醉经过、手术入路和是否完整切除。
unknowns.en: The imaging modality of the mass, its size on imaging and its relation to the airway and great vessels; any breathing or circulatory symptoms; the anaesthetic course, the surgical approach and whether the resection was complete.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病理分级（成熟或未成熟）、有无其他生殖细胞成分，以及是否给予其他治疗。
unknowns.en: The histological grade (mature or immature), any other germ-cell elements, and whether any other treatment was given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后经过；“一年随访”从何时算起；随访时的LH/FSH、骨龄和生长；一年以后的青春期、生长、生育和Klinefelter综合征的照护。
unknowns.en: The post-operative course; where the "one year" of follow-up is counted from; LH/FSH, bone age and growth at follow-up; puberty, growth, fertility and Klinefelter care beyond one year.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用药、过敏、疫苗、外源性激素接触、家族中的青春期发育年龄、各项体征出现的先后顺序，以及陪同家长是父亲还是母亲。
unknowns.en: Medicines, allergies, vaccinations, contact with outside hormones, the age of puberty in relatives, the order in which the signs appeared, and whether the parent with him is his mother or father.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: LH决定性腺轴的状态。ESPE/LWPES《GnRH类似物在儿童中应用的共识声明》（2009）：应使用灵敏的LH测定，并按所用刺激药物解读激发试验；提出的青春期前LH激发峰值上限约为3.3–5.0 IU/L（与测定方法有关）；性激素水平只能辅助诊断。2019年国际共识更新：切点取决于刺激药物、采血时间和测定方法。报告中0.1 IU/L的LH峰值远低于这些切点。
teachingPoints.en: LH decides the state of the axis. ESPE/LWPES consensus statement on the use of GnRH analogues in children (2009): use sensitive LH assays and read stimulation tests for the agent used; an assay-specific prepubertal limit for the stimulated LH peak of about 3.3–5.0 IU/L has been suggested; sex steroids support but do not make the diagnosis. The 2019 international consortium update: cut-offs depend on the stimulus, the sampling time and the assay. The report's LH peak of 0.1 IU/L lies far below them.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: GnRH类似物只治疗中枢性性早熟。ESPE/LWPES共识（2009）：GnRH类似物是中枢性性早熟的标准治疗，用于其他情况需要进一步研究、不能常规推荐。外周性性早熟要治疗来源；去除来源后若出现继发中枢性青春期，先用LH证实，再考虑GnRH类似物。
teachingPoints.en: GnRH analogues treat central puberty only. ESPE/LWPES consensus (2009): GnRH analogues are the standard of care for central precocious puberty, and their use for other conditions requires further study and cannot be suggested routinely. Peripheral precocity is treated at its source; central puberty that follows once the source is removed is first shown by LH, then considered for a GnRH analogue.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: Klinefelter综合征与纵隔生殖细胞肿瘤，两个方向都要想到。EAA《Klinefelter综合征指南》（2021，欧洲内分泌学会认可）：性腺外生殖细胞肿瘤发生率增高，主要在纵隔，多为非精原细胞瘤（成熟畸胎瘤或混合性肿瘤），年龄小的男孩可因hCG表现为性早熟。NCI PDQ（2024）：Klinefelter综合征增加纵隔生殖细胞肿瘤的风险，且发病年龄更小，应考虑对年轻男性患者做Klinefelter检测。
teachingPoints.en: Klinefelter syndrome and mediastinal germ-cell tumours — think in both directions. EAA guideline on Klinefelter syndrome (2021, endorsed by the European Society of Endocrinology): extragonadal germ-cell tumours are more frequent, mainly mediastinal and usually non-seminomas (mature teratomas or mixed tumours), and younger boys may present with precocious puberty due to hCG production. NCI PDQ (2024): Klinefelter syndrome raises the risk of mediastinal germ-cell tumours, which present younger, and testing younger males with these tumours for Klinefelter syndrome should be considered.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 前纵隔肿物首先是麻醉风险。SPA病例指南《前纵隔肿物患者的麻醉》（2024）：麻醉前问气道受压（咳嗽、气促、喘鸣、声嘶、端坐呼吸）和心血管受压（晕厥、心动过速、颈静脉怒张、上腔静脉综合征）的表现；用胸部CT评估气道、大血管和心脏受压；有压迫或积液时做经胸心脏超声；即使没有症状也可能在全麻诱导时塌陷；尽量避免全麻，必须全麻时保留自主呼吸；进行多学科讨论。报告没有记录他的症状、气道评估或麻醉经过。
teachingPoints.en: An anterior mediastinal mass is first an anaesthetic hazard. SPA case guide, Anesthesia for patients with anterior mediastinal mass (2024): before anaesthesia ask about airway compression (cough, dyspnoea, stridor, hoarseness, orthopnoea) and cardiovascular compression (syncope, tachycardia, distended neck veins, superior vena cava syndrome); assess compression of the airway, great vessels and heart on chest CT; add a transthoracic echocardiogram if there is compression or an effusion; collapse can occur on induction even without symptoms; avoid general anaesthesia where possible and keep spontaneous ventilation if needed; hold a multidisciplinary huddle. The report records none of his symptoms, airway assessment or anaesthetic course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 畸胎瘤的治疗和随访。NCI PDQ《儿童颅外生殖细胞肿瘤治疗》（2024）：畸胎瘤的主要治疗是完整手术切除；包括纵隔在内的成熟畸胎瘤以手术加观察治疗，未成熟畸胎瘤也主要以手术加观察处理；良性和未成熟畸胎瘤可有AFP和β-hCG的小幅升高，以成熟或未成熟成分为主的畸胎瘤中可能有少量恶性成分；所有儿童术后3年内都要频繁复查肿瘤标志物。报告的一年随访——β-hCG 0.7 IU/L，胸片未见异常，因这些结果未复查MRI——没有记录病理分级和是否完整切除，这正是需要继续监测的原因。
teachingPoints.en: Treating and following a teratoma. NCI PDQ, Childhood Extracranial Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (2024): the primary treatment of teratomas is complete resection; mature teratomas, including those of the mediastinum, are treated with surgery and observation, and immature teratomas primarily with surgery and observation; benign and immature teratomas may produce small elevations of AFP and β-hCG, and malignant elements may form a small fraction of a predominantly mature or immature teratoma; markers are measured frequently for 3 years in all children. The report's one-year review — β-hCG 0.7 IU/L, a chest radiograph with no abnormality, the MRI not repeated because of these results — leaves the grade and the completeness of resection unrecorded, which is why monitoring continues.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: Klinefelter综合征的儿童期照护和检查时的隐私。EAA指南（2021）：向患者和父母提供遗传咨询；青春期前儿童如有需要给予言语治疗、学习监测、社交训练和心理支持；不对婴儿和青春期前男孩用睾酮；从预计青春期开始之前起评估青春期发育、睾酮和促性腺激素；青春期延迟或性腺功能减退时、讨论生育问题后再用睾酮。AAP政策声明（2025）：敏感部位检查是否陪检、由谁陪检，由患儿、家长和医生共同决定。他在一年随访时睾酮8.49 nmol/L，需要查LH和肿瘤标志物来判断是已进入中枢性青春期，还是仍有来源。
teachingPoints.en: Childhood care in Klinefelter syndrome, and privacy in the examination. EAA guideline (2021): offer genetic counselling to patients and parents; speech therapy, monitoring of learning, social training and psychological support for pre-pubertal children if needed; no testosterone in infants and pre-pubertal boys; assess pubertal development, testosterone and gonadotropins from before the expected start of puberty, and give testosterone for delayed puberty or hypogonadism after fertility has been addressed. AAP policy statement (2025): whether a chaperone is used for sensitive examinations, and who, is decided jointly by the patient, parent and clinician. His testosterone of 8.49 nmol/L at one year needs LH and the markers to tell whether central puberty has begun or a source remains.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（包括血压），以及皮肤、心肺、神经系统和视野等其他检查。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (including blood pressure), and the skin, cardiorespiratory, neurological and visual-field examinations.

unknowns.zh-CN: 基础LH和FSH、各项参考范围、激发药物和采血时间点；17-羟孕酮、DHEA-S和雄烯二酮；AFP数值（报告中部分单位有疑问）；β-hCG的采血时间与胸部影像和手术的先后关系。
unknowns.en: Basal LH and FSH, the reference ranges, the stimulating agent and sampling times; 17-OHP, DHEA-S and androstenedione; the AFP values (some units in the report are questionable); when the β-hCG was taken relative to the chest imaging and the operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肿物的影像方式、大小以及与气道和大血管的关系；有无呼吸或循环症状；麻醉经过、手术入路和是否完整切除。
unknowns.en: The imaging modality of the mass, its size on imaging and its relation to the airway and great vessels; any breathing or circulatory symptoms; the anaesthetic course, the surgical approach and whether the resection was complete.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病理分级（成熟或未成熟）、有无其他生殖细胞成分，以及是否给予其他治疗。
unknowns.en: The histological grade (mature or immature), any other germ-cell elements, and whether any other treatment was given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后经过；“一年随访”从何时算起；随访时的LH/FSH、骨龄和生长；一年以后的青春期、生长、生育和Klinefelter综合征的照护。
unknowns.en: The post-operative course; where the "one year" of follow-up is counted from; LH/FSH, bone age and growth at follow-up; puberty, growth, fertility and Klinefelter care beyond one year.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用药、过敏、疫苗、外源性激素接触、家族中的青春期发育年龄、各项体征出现的先后顺序，以及陪同家长是父亲还是母亲。
unknowns.en: Medicines, allergies, vaccinations, contact with outside hormones, the age of puberty in relatives, the order in which the signs appeared, and whether the parent with him is his mother or father.
